interpretation: Existing Melange measures only. No voter-level predictors or political-support probabilities are computed.

systems.name: Credit-union footprint
systems.formula: 100 x sum(component percentile x chosen policy weight). Percentiles are tie-aware and calculated separately within district and state markets, using full-precision employment and establishment location quotients and un-inverted CU branch/deposit shares -- higher current credit-union footprint scores higher. Missing evidence is neutral at 0.50 and lowers the displayed evidence-coverage rate.
systems.qualification: Qualifies when the district or state credit-union employment location quotient (full precision, not the 3dp display rounding) is >= 1.00 -- credit-union employment there is at least as concentrated as it is nationally.
systems.missing: Existing Melange method uses neutral 0.50 and lowers evidence coverage. This app does not compute this score from the CSV.
systems.normalization: Tie-aware percentiles within qualifying district or state markets; full precision.

rows.name: CU employment concentration (LQ)
rows.definition: CU-sector (NAICS 522130) employment location quotient: (local CU employment / local all-industry employment) / (U.S. CU employment / U.S. all-industry employment)
rows.caveat: LQ is concentration relative to the national CU workforce share, not absolute employment scale or growth.

rows.name: CU establishment concentration (LQ)
rows.definition: CU-sector (NAICS 522130) establishment location quotient: (local CU establishments / local all-industry establishments) / (U.S. CU establishments / U.S. all-industry establishments)
rows.caveat: LQ is concentration of establishment counts, not employment or deposit scale.

rows.name: CU branch share
rows.definition: CU branches / (CU branches + FDIC-insured bank branches)
rows.caveat: Branch locations are geocoded/allocated to districts; unmatched and county-fallback records create estimation error.

rows.name: CU deposit share
rows.definition: estimated CU shares / (FDIC bank deposits + estimated CU shares)
rows.caveat: NCUA institution shares are divided equally across allocation-eligible CU branches, while FDIC reports branch deposits. This is a cross-system proxy, not a directly observed market share.

systems.name: Congressional ranking
systems.normalization: Legislation and demographics use percent ranks; press and influence divide by their respective maxima. Preserve source normalization.
systems.missing: The existing ranking is documented, not applied to source profiles.
systems.interpretation: Influence contributes 40%; this congressional ranking is not a pure measure of support.

systems.name: Evidence within an issue
systems.formula: Normalize source weights over available evidence. Nominal 0.10 media is not necessarily 10% of the result.
systems.normalization: Defensive categories: Interchange, CU Tax Status, Credit Card Mandates.
systems.missing: Absent evidence is not treated as opposition.

systems.name: Issue importance
systems.formula: Weighted mean across observed issue positions; relative weights do not represent fixed percentage contributions.
systems.normalization: The category "No recorded position" is excluded from the overall stance mean; retain the source semantic ladder.
systems.missing: Unknown is excluded, not scored as zero support.

The documented 25/30/40/5 ranking differs from the inspected current 45/10/40/5 code and page.

rejected_proxies.reason: Labor-union support is not credit-union support.
Modeled activism does not document repeated CU engagement.
Does not establish CU-specific participation or persistence.
Election participation does not measure CU support.
